lines.sentence: As you cross near a seabed, a pleasant song flits across your ears as you feel your body relax at the sound.
Don’t you hear that, friend of mine? That music is a blessing sent from the heavens. I must learn its origin. I must see what beautiful maiden sings to me.
It takes you too long to shake off the appeal of the music, and now, creatures, half-bird half-woman, descend upon you.
